title: Who is Zhang Yiming? Meet the TikTok founder and Asia's richest person, surpassing Gautam Adani
summary: Zhang Yiming founded ByteDance Ltd in 2012 in a four-bedroom Beijing apartment and developed the news aggregator Toutiao and the video-sharing platform TikTok.

title: Who is Alexandre Arnault, the LVMH top executive appointed to Nike's Board of Directors?
summary: NIKE, Inc. appointed Alexandre Arnault, Deputy CEO of Moët Hennessy, to its Board of Directors. His experience in brand innovation and digital transformation is expected to enhance NIKE's consumer connections and support its growth strategy globally.

title: Tax audit filing deadline 2026: CA bodies seek extension to October 31, what taxpayers should do
summary: The September 30, 2026 deadline for filing tax audit reports for AY 2026-27 is nearing, while several CA and tax professional bodies have asked the government to extend it to October 31. No CBDT extension has been announced yet.

title: How UPI MDR could undermine the economics of low-cost investing
summary: The argument that the cost of innovation needs money doesn't really warrant a percentage of transaction. Technology costs should come down as transactions grow.

title: SGB 2019-20 Series IV redemption today at  ₹15,173:  ₹1 lakh investment grows to nearly  ₹3.95 lakh
summary: SGB 2019-20 Series IV investors can prematurely redeem their bonds at  ₹15,173 per gram on September 17, 2026, taking the value of a  ₹1 lakh online investment to about  ₹3.95 lakh, excluding interest. The bond has delivered a 295.13% absolute gain on the discounted issue price.

title: Bitcoin sale triggered  ₹1.24 crore tax addition, but ITAT quashed the reassessment. Here’s why
summary: A Mumbai ITAT has quashed a reassessment involving  ₹1.24 crore of bitcoin sale proceeds after finding that approval to reopen the AY 2018-19 assessment came from the wrong authority under Section 151.&nbsp;

title: Gold, silver prices today, 17 September: Check retail rates of 24K, 22K gold, 999 silver in Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata
summary: Gold and silver prices remained volatile on September 17 after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points, with global bullion prices recovering after the previous session’s fall.
